summaryZh: 2026年农业无人机产品线全面扩展，涵盖8加仑紧凑机型到40加仑大容量机型，日覆盖面积超1000英亩。新产品包括Revolution R40、Airstrike Ag P150 Max自主作业无人机、Independence 19美国制造机型，以及Ceres Air自动补给站、Echo可拆卸无人机坞等配套基础设施。侦察技术方面，TerraScout可日扫描1000英亩并检测杂草、石块和作物株数。价格从4000美元喷雾底座到72000美元完整高容量无人机套装不等。
featuredReason: 虽然本文聚焦大田作物无人机，但其自动补给站、可拆卸无人机坞、发电配套等基础设施方案对智慧畜牧领域的无人机应用（如牧场巡检、饲料投喂）具有直接借鉴意义，且展示了农业自动化设备的最新商业化进展。

Farming Equipment

Technology

New wave of ag drones ready for fields

What’s New From the Shows: New drone and support equipment expands agricultural aviation options.

Andy Castillo,Editor of Farm Equipment and Machinery,Farm ProgressSeptember 30, 2026

photo_library8 Slides

play_arrowStart slideshow

Agricultural drone technology continues expanding with new products focused on both aircraft and support systems. The 2026 lineup includes drones ranging from compact 8-gallon models to large 40-gallon units capable of covering over 1,000 acres daily.

High-capacity options lead the new releases. The Revolution R40 carries 40 gallons and covers 95 to 110 acres per hour, while the Airstrike Ag P150 Max features fully autonomous operation with onboard decision-making. The Independence 19 stands out as 78% American-made with a 20-gallon capacity and complete turnkey package.

Support infrastructure receives significant attention this year. Ceres Air’s Endless Spray automated refill station handles battery changes and tank refills without operator intervention, keeping drones flying continuously. Echo Equipment’s removable Drone Dock provides a 40-by-24-foot working platform that detaches from trailers in 10 minutes.

Related:Catch equipment problems before they cost you

Power generation options include Husker Power Products’ 30 kW generator with solid-state protection and Gen Aer’s quiet 40-kW diesel unit meeting Tier 4 emissions standards. For high-volume applications, the Ceres Air HV Spray Base pushes 20 gallons per minute through eight nozzles.

Scouting technology advances with TerraClear’s TerraScout, covering 1,000 acres daily while detecting weeds, rocks and stand counts. The 60-foot boom system captures millions of field photos at 15 mph.

Pricing spans from $4,000 for spray bases to $72,000 for complete high-capacity drone packages, with support equipment ranging from $23,000 to $60,000 depending on capabilities.

About the Author

Andy Castillo

Editor of Farm Equipment and Machinery, Farm Progress

Andy Castillo started his career in journalism about a decade ago as a television news cameraperson and producer before transitioning to a regional newspaper covering western Massachusetts, where he wrote about local farming. Between military deployments with the Air Force and covering the news, he earned an MFA in creative nonfiction writing from Bay Path University, building on the English degree he earned from the University of Massachusetts Amherst. In his role at Farm Progress, Castillo covers agricultural technology, new machinery and the constantly evolving farm equipment marketplace.

Castillo splits his time between the open road and western Massachusetts with his wife, Brianna, a travel nurse who specializes in pediatric oncology, and their rescue pup, Rio. When not attending farm shows, Castillo enjoys playing music, snowboarding, writing, cooking and restoring their 1920 craftsman bungalow. You can find Castillo at farm machinery shows across the country.

农业无人机技术持续扩展，新产品同时聚焦飞行器和支持系统。2026年产品阵容包括从紧凑型8加仑机型到大型40加仑机型，后者每日可覆盖超过1000英亩。

高容量选项引领新品发布。Revolution R40搭载40加仑容量，每小时覆盖95至110英亩，而Airstrike Ag P150 Max具备完全自主运行和机载决策能力。Independence 19以78%美国制造率脱颖而出，拥有20加仑容量和完整交钥匙方案。

配套基础设施今年受到显著关注。Ceres Air的Endless Spray自动补给站无需操作员干预即可完成电池更换和药箱加注，使无人机持续飞行。Echo Equipment的可拆卸Drone Dock提供40×24英尺工作平台，可在10分钟内从拖车上拆下。

发电选项包括Husker Power Products的30千瓦发电机，配备固态保护，以及Gen Aer的静音40千瓦柴油机组，满足Tier 4排放标准。对于大流量应用，Ceres Air HV Spray Base通过八个喷嘴每分钟推送20加仑。

侦察技术方面，TerraClear的TerraScout每日覆盖1000英亩，同时检测杂草、石块和作物株数。60英尺喷杆系统以15英里/小时速度拍摄数百万张田间照片。

价格从4000美元的喷雾底座到72000美元的完整高容量无人机套装不等，支持设备价格在23000至60000美元之间，具体取决于功能配置。
